messages.content: get best, worst and exoected runtime for all the algorithms in this book

Below is every algorithm from the CLRS study guide with best-, worst-, and expected-case runtimes. "Expected" is listed only for randomized algorithms; for deterministic algorithms the average case (under typical inputs) is noted where given. Worst-case is the default when only one runtime is cited.

---

### Chapter 2 — Getting Started

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insertion sort | Θ(n) | Θ(n²) | Θ(n²) |
| Merge sort | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n lg n) |
| Selection sort | Θ(n²) | Θ(n²) | Θ(n²) |
| Linear search | Θ(1) | Θ(n) | Θ(n) |
| Binary search | Θ(1) | Θ(lg n) | Θ(lg n) |
| Horner's rule | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | Θ(n) |

### Chapter 4 — Divide-and-Conquer

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Strassen's matrix mult | Θ(n^{lg 7}) | Θ(n^{lg 7}) | — |
| Naïve D&C matrix mult | Θ(n³) | Θ(n³) | — |
| FIND-MAX-SUBARRAY (D&C) | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n lg n) | — |
| Kadane's algorithm | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | — |

### Chapter 5 — Probabilistic Analysis

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| HIRE-ASSISTANT | O(n) | O(n²) | O(c·n + ·H_n) |
| RANDOMLY-PERMUTE | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | — |
| PERMUTE-BY-SORTING | O(n lg n) | O(n lg n) | — |
| Online hiring (secretary) | — | — | success prob → 1/e |

### Chapter 6 — Heapsort

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Heapsort | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n lg n) |
| BUILD-MAX-HEAP | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | — |
| MAX-HEAPIFY | Θ(lg n) | Θ(lg n) | — |

### Chapter 7 — Quicksort

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| QUICKSORT (deterministic) | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n²) | Θ(n lg n) |
| RANDOMIZED-QUICKSORT | Θ(n lg n) | Θ(n²) | Θ(n lg n) |
| PARTITION | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | — |
| HOARE-PARTITION | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | — |

### Chapter 8 — Sorting in Linear Time

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Counting sort | Θ(n+k) | Θ(n+k) | — |
| Radix sort | Θ(d(n+k)) | Θ(d(n+k)) | — |
| Bucket sort | Θ(n) | Θ(n²) | Θ(n) |
| Comparison-sort lower bound | — | Ω(n lg n) | — |

### Chapter 9 — Medians & Order Statistics

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| RANDOMIZED-SELECT | Θ(n) | Θ(n²) | Θ(n) |
| SELECT (Blum-Floyd-Pratt-Rivest-Tarjan) | Θ(n) | Θ(n) | — |

### Chapter 10 — Elementary Data Structures

| Operation | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stack push/pop | O(1) | O(1) | — |
| Queue enqueue/dequeue | O(1) | O(1) | — |
| Linked-list search | Θ(1) | Θ(n) | Θ(n) |
| Linked-list insert/delete (known pos) | O(1) | O(1) | — |

### Chapter 11 — Hash Tables

| Operation | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search / Insert / Delete | O(1) | O(n) | O(1) |

### Chapter 12 — Binary Search Trees

| Operation | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search / Insert / Delete | O(1) | O(n) | O(lg n) |

### Chapter 13 — Red-Black Trees

| Operation | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search / Insert / Delete | O(lg n) | O(lg n) | — |

### Chapter 14 — Dynamic Programming

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rod cutting | — | O(n²) | — |
| Matrix-chain multiplication | — | O(n³) | — |
| Longest common subsequence | — | O(mn) | — |
| Optimal BST | — | O(n³) | — |

### Chapter 15 — Greedy Algorithms

| Algorithm | Best | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| Activity selection (after sort) | — | Θ(n) | — |
| Activity selection (with sort) | — | O(n lg n) | — |
| Huffman coding | — | O(n lg n) | — |

### Chapter 16 — Amortized Analysis

| Structure | Operation | Amortized cost |
|---|---|---|
| Dynamic table (insert) | INSERT | O(1) |
| Binary counter | INCREMENT | O(1) |
| Stack with MULTIPOP | PUSH/POP/MULTIPOP | O(1) per element |

### Chapter 18 — B-Trees

| Operation | Worst |
|---|---|
| Search | O(lg n) |
| Insert | O(lg n) |
| Delete | O(lg n) |

### Chapter 19 — Disjoint Sets

| Operation | Worst (amortized) |
|---|---|
| MAKE-SET / FIND-SET / UNION | O(α(n)) (inverse Ackermann) |

### Chapter 20 — Elementary Graph Algorithms

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| BFS | O(V + E) |
| DFS | O(V + E) |
| Topological sort | O(V + E) |
| Strongly connected components | O(V + E) |

### Chapter 21 — Minimum Spanning Trees

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Kruskal | O(E lg V) or O(E α(V)) |
| Prim (binary heap) | O(E lg V) |
| Prim (Fibonacci heap) | O(E + V lg V) |

### Chapter 22 — Single-Source Shortest Paths

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Dijkstra (array) | O(V²) |
| Dijkstra (Fibonacci heap) | O(E + V lg V) |
| Bellman-Ford | O(VE) |
| DAG shortest path | O(V + E) |

### Chapter 23 — All-Pairs Shortest Paths

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Floyd-Warshall | O(|V|³) |
| Johnson | O(V² lg V + VE) |

### Chapter 24 — Maximum Flow

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Ford-Fulkerson | O(E |f*|) |
| Edmonds-Karp | O(VE²) |
| Dinic (on unit-capacity) | O(E√V) |

### Chapter 25 — Matching

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Gale-Shapley (stable marriage) | O(n²) |
| Hopcroft-Karp (bipartite matching) | O(E√V) |

### Chapter 26 — Parallel Algorithms

| Problem | Span | Work |
|---|---|---|
| Parallel sum (balanced tree) | Θ(lg n) | Θ(n) |
| Parallel Fibonacci | Θ(φⁿ) / O(lg n) | varies |
| Merge sort (parallel) | Θ(lg³ n) | Θ(n lg n) |

### Chapter 27 — Online Algorithms

| Problem | Competitive ratio |
|---|---|
| Ski rental | 2 |
| Move-to-Front (list access) | 2 |
| LRU caching (k-fault) | k |
| Elevator (SCAN) | — |

### Chapter 28 — Matrix Operations

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| LUP decomposition | O(n³) |
| Matrix inversion (via LUP) | O(n³) |

### Chapter 29 — Linear Programming

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Simplex | exponential (rare) |
| Ellipsoid | O(n⁶ L²) (poly) |

### Chapter 30 — FFT

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| FFT (Cooley-Tukey) | Θ(n lg n) |
| Naïve DFT | Θ(n²) |

### Chapter 31 — Number-Theoretic Algorithms

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Euclid's GCD | O(lg b) |
| Extended Euclid | O(lg b) |
| Repeated squaring (modular exp) | O(lg b) |
| RSA | O(lg³ n) |
| Miller-Rabin (probabilistic) | O(k lg³ n) |

### Chapter 32 — String Matching

| Algorithm | Worst | Expected / Avg |
|---|---|---|
| Naïve matcher | O((n-m+1)m) | — |
| Rabin-Karp | O(nm) | Θ(n+m) |
| KMP | Θ(n+m) | — |

### Chapter 33 — Machine Learning Algorithms

| Algorithm | Worst |
|---|---|
| Perceptron | O(d·R²/γ²) iterations |
| Linear regression (normal eq.) | O(nd²) |
| k-NN | O(nd) per query |
| k-means | O(nkt) |
| Decision tree (ID3) | O(m·n·2^m) |

### Chapter 34 — NP-Completeness

| Problem | Best-known |
|---|---|
| Circuit-SAT | 2^{O(n)} |
| SAT / 3-CNF-SAT | O(1.30704ⁿ) |
| CLIQUE | O(1.1888ⁿ) |
| VERTEX-COVER | O(1.2738^k + kn) |
| HAM-CYCLE / TSP | O(2ⁿ) |
| SUBSET-SUM (meet-in-middle) | O(2^{n/2}) |

### Chapter 35 — Approximation Algorithms

| Problem | Ratio | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Vertex cover (maximal matching) | 2 | O(V+E) |
| Set cover (greedy) | H(max|S|) | O(n·H(m)) |
| TSP (MST-based) | 2 | O(V²) |
| Subset-sum (DP) | (1+ε) | O(n·t) |
| MAX-3-CNF-SAT (random) | ⅞ | — |

---

This covers every algorithm with explicit runtime bounds in the study guide. For deterministic algorithms "expected" is omitted (best/worst are the bounds). For randomized algorithms (e.g. RANDOMIZED-QUICKSORT, RANDOMIZED-SELECT) the expected case is distinct from worst case.
